ticket.codeHint: Tell it to the admin when you join the room.
ticket.step1: Join our Discord if you have not yet.
ticket.step2: Add the admin in game or wait for their invite.
ticket.step3: At your time, join the voice room and say your code.
ticket.cancelConfirm: Are you sure? Your slot and reserved stock will be released.
ticket.cancelError: It cannot be cancelled: the appointment is too close or the order has moved on. Message us on Discord.
ticket.notFound: We could not find this appointment in your account.
ticket.step4: Record the full match, from joining the squad until you extract. It is your evidence if you need to file a claim.
ticket.confirmText: The admin marked your order as delivered. If you extracted with everything you ordered, confirm it. If something went wrong, do not confirm: file a claim in #support on Discord within 24 hours with the match recording.
ticket.confirmCheck: I extracted with the items in my order and I confirm the delivery. I understand I cannot claim a loss afterwards.
ticket.confirmed: Receipt confirmed on {{date}}. Thanks for your purchase!
ticket.confirmError: Could not confirm. Reload the page and try again.
